question: Should OpenClaw adopt this SQLite-authoritative convergence policy across all six migration families once archive failures are reliably preserved as blocking warnings?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes persisted-state retirement and which migration outcomes can block gateway readiness, so automation cannot safely choose that upgrade and availability policy.

options.title: Fix, accept, and land
options.body: Preserve archive warnings, add the focused regression, then accept the shared notice/archive policy and merge after exact-head checks.

options.title: Require copied-state upgrade replay
options.body: After the code fix, require a packaged first-run and second-run replay against affected legacy state before accepting the policy.

options.title: Pause for broader migration policy
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want one explicit cross-product policy before any further warning-to-notice downgrades.

recommendation.title: Fix, accept, and land
recommendation.body: Preserve archive warnings, add the focused regression, then accept the shared notice/archive policy and merge after exact-head checks.
